content: Healthcare professionals should provide educational materials that are culturally tailored for patients who do not speak English. These materials should specifically focus on diabetes prevention and awareness to ensure effective communication and understanding. The National Standards for Culturally and Linguistically Appropriate Services (CLAS) offer detailed guidance on how to reduce language barriers, improve cultural competency, and provide access to language assistance services. These measures are essential for enhancing the quality of care delivered to individuals who do not speak English.
